_description: Curated evaluation mapping for a diagnostic n=4 cross-document check of gt_01, gt_02, gt_03, gt_05. This file does NOT modify experiments/annotations/ground_truth_claim_pairs.json -- human_label and the original claim text are copied here read-only, for reference, so this file is self-contained and auditable without needing to cross-open the original. See experiments/reports/curated_mapping_rationale.md for the full rationale.

excluded_pairs.gt_04: Excluded per your read-only inspection: P5 has no extracted claim corresponding to this comparison.
excluded_pairs.gt_06: Excluded for the same reason as gt_04 (shares the P5 side of the pair).

same_paper_diagnostics_only.note: gt_07 and gt_08 remain out of scope for this curated mapping. They stay handled exactly as before: resolvable-but-same-paper pairs, evaluated separately from cross-document metrics wherever they appear (see scripts/evaluate_real_results.py), because Phase3Pipeline.run()'s candidate generator explicitly skips same-paper pairs. This file does not process gt_07/gt_08 at all.
